battle.name: 宋夏戰爭
battle.brief: 宋太宗太平興國六年六月以曹彬為陝西四路招討使分道伐夏，翌年正月進圍靈州不克，糧道斷絕引還，遭西夏騎兵邀擊於鳴沙，宋軍大潰。靈州城下的遠程壓制與攻城火力，正正落在卡面秦連弩所屬的連續射擊弩系譜所佔的位置。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 秦連弩在古代中國軍隊中屬於連續射擊型弩兵器，主要配置於步兵陣列與守城防線，位於前線壓制與城防火力環節。

countries: 交戰的兩方是北宋朝廷與党項夏國。982年的夏國尚未正式建國稱帝，名義上仍以夏州節度使李繼遷為首，但已控有河套至河西的大片牧地與靈州、鹽州等城寨，軍令由部族首領層層傳達，兵權與號令同出於李繼遷一身。北宋一方，太平興國六年（981）六月，太宗以曹彬為陝西四路招討使、潘多保副之，總五路兵自永興軍、環州、麟州等處分道出師，兵員兼有禁軍、廂軍與沿邊弓箭手、蕃兵，並配備輜重隊與攻城器械；後勤由陝西各路轉運司籌措，兵馬則經樞密院調發。地理條件上雙方正好相反：宋有稠密人口、成熟製弩與攻城技術，卻缺戰馬、缺就地糧秣，攻勢越深入西夏縱深，糧道越形拉長；夏有騎兵與熟悉山磧小道的嚮導，兵精而糧少，卻能憑靈州堅城與羊馬牆、界壕、烽燧構成的邊防體系死守。當時西夏仍以宋的藩屬名義行事，雙方在名號、封賞與榷場細節上往復交涉，軍事壓力與外交爭執同時進行。
countriesEn: The two parties in this campaign were the Northern Song court and the Tangut state of Western Xia. In 982 Xia had not yet proclaimed a dynasty in its own name; formally it was still the Xia prefecture under Li Bian, but it already held the grazing lands from the Hetao loop to Hexi together with strongholds such as Lingzhou and Yanzhou, and military orders passed down through the tribal chieftains with Li Bian alone holding both the armed forces and the seal of command. On the Song side, in the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo (981) Emperor Taizong appointed Cao Bin as Pacification Commissioner of the four circuits of Shaanxi, with Pan Duobao as his deputy, and led five columns out from Yongxing Army, Huan Prefecture and Lin Prefecture, drawing his men from the imperial guards, the provincial troops and the frontier archers and tribal auxiliaries, with baggage trains and siege equipment in support; logistics were organised by the transport offices of the various Shaanxi circuits, and the troops themselves were moved by the Bureau of Military Affairs. The two sides therefore faced one another with exactly inverted conditions: the Song had a dense population and mature crossbow-making and siege technology, but lacked warhorses and lacked supplies on the spot, and the deeper its advance into Xia territory ran, the longer its supply line grew; Xia had cavalry and guides who knew the desert tracks, troops that were sharp but short of food, yet it could hold behind the walls of Lingzhou with a frontier system of yangma walls, boundary ditches and beacon towers. At the time Xia still operated under Song suzerainty in name, and the two sides negotiated endlessly over titles, grants and market privileges, so that military pressure and diplomatic wrangling went on side by side.
people: 關鍵人物是宋太宗趙光義、曹彬、潘多保與西夏主李繼遷。宋太宗在太平興國五年滅北漢、又於高梁河敗於遼軍之後，把目光轉向西北，意圖趁西夏尚未稱帝、力量未整時一舉清除側翼，於太平興國六年下令出師。曹彬是本役主帥，此人治軍嚴整、進止有度，《宋史》本傳稱其為將恭謹而恤士，至於本役則被詬病糧道失備、進退失據，兵敗之後因責貶官。潘多保為副將，與曹彬同掌一路，敗後同遭貶謫。西夏方面，李繼遷拒絕宋廷的封爵與撫賞，與宋使往返爭辯名號與歲賜，同時以兵相逼；他在太平興國七年（982）七月病卒，其子李德明於太平興國八年（983）嗣位，邊局隨之改觀。宋軍在鳴沙遭追擊一役的主動出擊者，史書多不載其姓名，只記為李繼遷麾下精騎，諸說並存，不可硬指；宋廷內部對是否出兵亦有主張持重與主張速決兩派，太宗最終採納了出兵一途。
peopleEn: The key figures are Emperor Taizong Zhao Guangyi, Cao Bin, Pan Duobao and the Xia ruler Li Bian. After destroying Northern Han in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo and then being beaten by the Khitan at Gaoliang River, Taizong turned his gaze northwest, intending to remove the western flank in one stroke while Xia had not yet proclaimed itself emperor and had not yet recovered its strength, and in the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo he ordered the expedition. Cao Bin was the commander in this campaign, a man whose command was strict and orderly, whose service record in the History of Song praises him as a cautious general who cared for his soldiers; for this campaign, however, he was faulted for a badly managed supply line and for advancing and withdrawing wrongly, and after the defeat he was demoted on account of it. Pan Duobao was his deputy and shared a command with him, and was likewise demoted. On the Xia side, Li Bian refused the Song court's titles and gratuities, argued with Song envoys over the terms of investiture and the annual gifts while at the same time pressing with troops, and he died of illness in the seventh month of Taiping Xingguo (982); his son Li Deming took the throne in the eighth year of Taiping Xingguo (983) and the shape of the frontier changed with him. The commanders of the Xia force that overtook the Song army on its retreat from Mingsha are not named in the histories, which record only elite cavalry under Li Bian; several accounts exist and one should not insist on any single name. Within the Song court there were also men who urged caution and men who called for a quick decision, and the emperor in the end took the road of sending the army.
kits: 本卡兵器是秦連弩，即以機括連發的蹶張弩。此器成形於戰國末至秦代，秦簡所載兵法與出土弩機可見其形制：弩身備有自鎖機關與儲矢之匣，張弦之後可保持滿弦待發，射手只須扣動機括便可反覆射出，是先秦步卒陣列與城防火力中最擅長連續射擊的一環；漢承秦制，兩漢邊塞與漢弩同傳，魏晉以降諸葛弩之名的流傳亦與此一脈相承。但到982年，這一系譜已退居次要：宋人弓弩譜中承其思路者，是蹶張或腰張蓄力的神臂弓與床子弩，另有大量步弩、馬弓，攻城則以砲石、雲梯、撞竿、對樓、望車為主，另有櫓與拒馬護住進攻梯隊。史書對靈州之役中宋軍究竟使用哪一型強弩記載有限，只能確定遠程壓制與城頭對射仍由弓弩擔任主力，而攻城火力的骨幹已是砲石而非弩箭。西夏一方則以騎兵弓刀為主，長柄槊與刀斧相配，甲胄以皮札為多，倚城時用羊馬牆、界壕與陷坑限制騎兵衝撞。糧秣方面，宋軍靠車隊自關中運出，輔以役夫畜力；夏軍靠騎兵就地取給，這正是兩軍在靈州城下耗不下去的分野。
kitsEn: The weapon on this card is the Qin repeating crossbow, that is, the tensed foot crossbow worked by a lock mechanism. Its form took shape in the late Warring States and in the Qin: military texts carried on Qin bamboo slips and the crossbow locks excavated from tombs show the principle, a crossbow body fitted with a self-holding lock and a magazine of bolts, which keeps the string at full draw after being bent, so that the archer need only press the trigger to shoot again and again; it was the element of the pre-Qin infantry line and city defence best adapted to sustained fire. The Han inherited the Qin pattern, carried the crossbow into the frontier forts and named its own crossbow accordingly, and the later fame of Zhuge crossbows under the Wei and Jin runs back into the same line. By 982, however, that line had become secondary: in the Song crossbow catalogues the inheritors of the idea were the shenbi crossbow and the bed crossbow, tensed by foot or by waist, together with great numbers of ordinary infantry crossbows and horse bows; for siege work the mainstay was stone-throwing artillery, scaling ladders, battering poles, fighting towers and observation cars, with shields and cheval-de-frise protecting the assault columns. The histories record very little about which particular heavy crossbow the Song army actually used at Lingzhou; what can be established is that long-range suppression and the exchange of fire from the walls still fell to bows and crossbows, while the backbone of the siege had already become stone artillery rather than bolts. On the Xia side the principal weapons were the bow, the sabre and the spear carried by cavalry, matched with long-hafted lances, knives and axes, with armour mostly of hide and lacquered plates; when relying on walls they used yangma walls, boundary ditches and pits to check the charge of horsemen. In the matter of supply, the Song army lived on wagon trains hauled out from Guanzhong together with the labour of porters and draught animals, whereas the Xia troops subsisted on the spot by cavalry, and that was exactly the divide that could not be sustained beneath the walls of Lingzhou.
tactics: 宋軍的戰法是典型的分道齊進加強攻城：五路兵自不同州府出發，前鋒連拔烏池、牛皮川一帶寨堡，然後向靈州收攏，企圖以雲梯、穴地與砲石壓制城頭，奪取東南方向通往興州與鹽州的一條通道。但宋軍的戰術有三處破綻：一是糧道自關中沿無定河、葫蘆河迂迴北運，夏軍不必解圍，只要以輕騎不斷抄掠糧隊與援道，宋軍便越打越瘦；二是兵種搭配失衡，步卒多而戰馬少，一旦攻城不下、營壘被逼，就缺乏騎兵掩護斷後；三是攻堅時把主力壓在城外空曠地，缺少木柵、拒馬與壕溝連成的營防體系，結果一旦後路被切，城頭火力仍在，城下隊列卻先散。西夏的戰法是以守待勞：憑靈州堅城與羊馬牆、界壕拖延，等待宋軍糧盡生變，然後以精騎在退路上邀擊。宋軍果真在糧援俱竭時全軍退兵，於鳴沙一帶被追上邀擊，隊列崩潰，甲兵糧芻棄失甚多。此役之後宋廷改弦更張，轉向橫山築城置寨、修築界壕，以堡寨與邊壕構成的點線防禦逐步取代深入的運動戰。
tacticsEn: The Song method was the classic combination of converging columns and heavy siege: five columns set out from different prefectures, the vanguard pulled down a string of stockades in the Wuchi and Niupichuan area, and then the host converged on Lingzhou in the hope of using scaling ladders, mine tunnels and stone artillery to beat down the walls and open the road running south-east towards Xingzhou and Yanzhou. Yet three flaws marked the Song tactics. First, the supply line ran north from Guanzhong by a circuitous route along the Wuding and Hulu rivers; Xia did not need to break the siege at all, for it only had to send light cavalry to harry the grain convoys and the reinforcement road, and the Song army would grow thinner with every month. Second, the balance of arms was wrong: infantry were many and warhorses few, so once the siege stalled and the camp was pressed, there were no horsemen to cover the withdrawal. Third, the assault was committed in open ground outside the walls, without the line of stakes, cheval-de-frise and ditches that should have tied the camp together, and so the moment the rear was cut the wall batteries went on firing while the column outside came apart. Xia fought the method of waiting out the attacker: it leaned on the solid walls of Lingzhou, on the yangma walls and the boundary ditches, waited for the Song army's supplies to fail, and then sent elite cavalry to intercept the retreat. The Song army did withdraw when grain and reinforcement had both run out, was overtaken around Mingsha, and broke up, leaving armour, provisions and baggage in great quantity. After this the Song court changed course, turning to build forts and stockades in Hengshan and to dig boundary ditches, and the line-and-point defence of forts and trenches gradually replaced the deep offensive into Xia territory.
data: 可考可證的數字如下。出兵在太平興國六年（981）六月，敗退在太平興國七年（982）正月，前後逾半年；圍攻靈州歷時數十日而不能下，靈州距宋軍退兵後遭伏的鳴沙約一百二十里，即六十餘公里；自永興軍至靈州逾千里，糧道全靠車隊與役夫畜力在無定河、葫蘆河沿線輾轉。人物方面，李繼遷於982年七月病卒，其子李德明於983年嗣位，宋夏的攻守重心自此轉移。就整體戰局的可比數字，1038年李元昊正式建國，1044年慶曆和議約定西夏每年受宋賜銀五萬兩、絹十三萬匹、茶二萬斤；1042年定川寨之戰宋軍九千餘人幾乎全軍覆沒；1082年永樂城之戰宋軍二十餘萬士卒役夫陣亡。就本役本身而言，宋軍出動兵力的確數、各部序列，以及鳴沙之敗的傷亡數字，《宋史》《宋資治通鑑》一類史籍皆未載明確數，諸說並存，本篇不作推算，亦不虛構。卡面秦連弩的年代距982年約一千二百年，是理解這條技術譜系的時間座標。
dataEn: The figures that can be supported are as follows. The army set out in the sixth month of the sixth year of Taiping Xingguo (981) and was beaten back in the first month of the seventh year (982), so the campaign lasted rather more than half a year; the siege of Lingzhou went on for a number of tens of days without success; the distance from Lingzhou to Mingsha, where the retreating Song army was ambushed, was about 120 li, that is a little over sixty kilometres; and the run from Yongxing Army to Lingzhou exceeded a thousand li, with the whole grain traffic moved by wagon teams, porters and draught animals along the Wuding and Hulu rivers. As to persons, Li Bian died of illness in the seventh month of 982, his son Li Deming succeeded him in 983, and the centre of gravity in the Song-Xia war shifted with that succession. For the wider war, comparable numbers are the following: Li Yuanhao founded the Xia state in 1038; the Qingli peace settlement of 1044 fixed the annual grant to Xia at 50,000 taels of silver, 130,000 bolts of silk and 20,000 jin of tea; at the battle of Dingchuanzhai in 1042 the Song force of more than 9,000 was very nearly wiped out; and at Yongle city in 1082 more than 200,000 Song soldiers and labourers were killed. As for this campaign itself, the exact size of the Song force, the order of its columns and the casualty figures of the defeat at Mingsha are all given in no explicit number in the History of Song and the Comprehensive Mirror, several accounts exist, and this account neither computes nor invents them. The date on the card, the Qin repeating crossbow, stands some twelve hundred years before 982 and marks the time reference for the whole technical line.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是宋廷的戰略選擇：太平興國五年宋太宗滅北漢，隨即乘勝攻遼卻在高梁河大敗，元氣受挫，轉而把西北視為可以一舉取得的側翼，而西夏此時已據靈州、鹽州，扼住宋與西北往來的正路，取靈州等於在宋夏之間插上一枚釘子。中層是名分與封賞的僵局：太宗曾以崇福軍節度使的名義及銀帛、茶賜李繼遷，條件是稱臣並罷去帝號，李繼遷上表謝罪而實不曲從，雙方使者往來爭的是節度使名號、歲賜數目與榷場待遇，話講不攏便回到刀兵。最內層是邊境衝突的加溫：981年前後夏軍進攻鄜州、坊州一線，掠奪邊寨與畜產，宋廷藉口出兵討伐，實則想在一次軍事行動中把西夏的實力與防線一併壓碎。三層糾纏在一起，最終形成五路大軍深入夏境的這場戰役。太平興國六年的出師在當時看來是低風險的機會主義：趁李繼遷未稱帝、元氣未復而速取靈州；只是誰也沒有算到，一支以步兵攻城為主的宋軍，在沒有騎兵護糧、沒有就地補給的黃河上游地帶，會被一支以騎兵為主的邊族軍隊拖到糧盡。
causeEn: There were three layers of reason behind the fighting. The outermost was a strategic choice of the Song court: having destroyed Northern Han in the fifth year of Taiping Xingguo and then gone over to attack the Khitan only to be beaten at Gaoliang River, Taizong was checked and turned to regard the northwest as a flank that might be seized in one stroke, while Xia by then held Lingzhou and Yanzhou and gripped the direct road between Song and the western regions, so that taking Lingzhou was like driving a spike between the two states. The middle layer was the deadlock over rank and reward: Taizong had offered Li Bian the title of Commissioner of Chongfu Army together with silver, silk and tea on condition that he acknowledge subjection and drop his claim to the imperial title; Li Bian sent a letter of apology but did not truly comply, and the envoys of both sides went back and forth over the name of the commission, the amount of the annual gifts and the terms of the border markets, and when words could not be settled the argument went back to steel. The innermost layer was the heating up of the frontier: around 981 the Xia army struck at Yuzhou and Fangzhou and raided the border stockades and herds, and the Song court used that as its pretext for a punitive expedition, in truth hoping to crush the Xia armed force and its defensive line in a single operation. The three layers fused into the campaign that sent five columns deep into Xia territory. The expedition of 981 looked at the time like low-risk opportunism: take Lingzhou quickly while Li Bian had not yet proclaimed himself emperor and had not recovered his strength. What nobody had reckoned on was that a Song army whose strength lay in infantry siege, marching in the upper Yellow River country without cavalry to guard its grain and without supplies to be found on the spot, would be starved out by a frontier army whose strength lay in horsemen.
impact: 此役的影響是深遠而帶有反諷意味的。一方面，它直接折斷了宋太宗西進的節奏：曹彬、潘多保貶職，士氣受挫，太宗把主要兵力轉回北面，兩年後以傾國之師攻遼，卻在雍熙北伐中慘敗，北宋此後確立重守內而輕外的國策，二十年不再大舉深入西北。另一方面，它替西夏買到了最需要的東西：時間。李繼遷在同年七月病卒，李德明接位後不急於稱帝，反而先整頓內政、與宋周旋，到1038年李元昊才正式建國，改元天授禮法延祚，國號大夏，十三年時間正是在宋軍被靈州與鳴沙拖住的同時積累出來的。戰術層面上，宋廷由此明白大軍深入無法持久，轉向橫山築堡設寨、修築界壕與羊馬牆，以堡寨和壕溝把騎兵的衝鋒逐段吃掉，此後宋夏邊界長達百餘年的拉鋸，多是在這種點線防禦的框架內進行。此役也把宋不能滅夏、夏不能滅宋的均勢長久地固定下來，直到1044年慶曆和議以封貢換取和平，1119年西夏正式向宋稱臣，1127年北宋覆亡、南宋與西夏不再接壤，這場延續三百餘年的宋夏戰爭才真正落幕。
impactEn: The effects of this campaign were far-reaching and faintly ironic. On the one hand it broke the rhythm of the Song court's advance westward: Cao Bin and Pan Duobao were demoted, morale was shaken, and the emperor turned his main strength back to the north, only to take the field against the Khitan two years later with everything the empire had, and to be badly beaten in the Yongxi northern expedition. The Northern Song then settled on a policy of guarding the interior and holding the exterior lightly, and for twenty years did not again drive deep into the northwest. On the other hand it bought Xia the one thing it most needed, which was time. Li Bian died in the seventh month of that same year; his son Li Deming did not hurry to proclaim himself emperor, but first put his own house in order and manoeuvred with the Song, and it was not until 1038 that Li Yuanhao formally founded the state, changed the era to Tian-shou Li-fa Yan-zuo and took the title of Great Xia. Those thirteen years were accumulated precisely while the Song army was being pinned down at Lingzhou and Mingsha. At the level of tactics, the Song court learned that a deep-pushing army could not be sustained and turned to building forts and stockades in Hengshan and digging boundary ditches and yangma walls, so as to eat the horsemen's charge piecemeal; the century-long see-saw along the Song-Xia border that followed was fought largely within that framework of point and line defence. The campaign also fixed for a long time the balance in which Song could not destroy Xia and Xia could not destroy Song, until the Qingli peace settlement of 1044 exchanged investiture and tribute for peace, until 1119 when Xia formally acknowledged itself a vassal of Song, and until 1127, when the fall of the Northern Song left the two states no longer sharing a border and the Song-Xia wars, which had run for more than three centuries, finally came to an end.
result: 結局對宋軍而言是明確的失敗。宋軍在太平興國六年一度攻入西夏縱深、連下數處寨堡，但在982年正月圍攻靈州不克，糧道被夏騎抄掠、援兵久絕，全軍被迫退兵，於鳴沙遭西夏騎兵邀擊，隊伍潰散，甲胄、糧芻與輜重棄失甚多，士卒死傷慘重；史書雖稱師潰，究竟陣亡多少人，各方記載互有出入，確數無從核實。主帥曹彬與副將潘多保因此獲罪貶職。這一場敗績的直接後果是：靈州仍在西夏手中，宋軍西出的通道沒有打開；宋廷西進計畫中止，國策轉向守內；雙方重新回到使者往來的桌子上。此後三年，太宗改採安撫手段，與新君李德明議定封爵與歲賜，邊境獲得喘息；宋廷則暗中在橫山修築堡寨、挖掘界壕，一步步削弱夏國的邊防縱深。從全盤看，982年之役既沒有摧毀西夏，也沒有打開通往西域的大道，它真正的結果是把北宋與西夏推入了一場長達三百餘年、以堡寨、壕溝、弓弩與騎兵為主角的邊境消耗戰之中。
resultEn: The outcome was an unambiguous defeat for the Song army. In 981 the Song had penetrated deep into Xia territory and pulled down a number of stockades, but in the first month of 982 the siege of Lingzhou failed, the grain road was harried by Xia horsemen, reinforcements had long ceased, and the whole army was forced to withdraw, only to be intercepted by Xia cavalry at Mingsha, where the columns broke up and armour, provisions and baggage were left in great quantity, with heavy losses among the men; the histories speak of a routed army, but on exactly how many were killed the accounts differ and no firm figure can be verified. The commander Cao Bin and his deputy Pan Duobao were found guilty and demoted for it. The immediate consequences of that defeat were these: Lingzhou remained in Xia hands, the road by which the Song could march west was not opened, the Song court's western plans were halted and its policy turned inward, and the two sides returned to the table of envoys. Over the following three years the emperor resorted to conciliation, settling with the new ruler Li Deming over investiture and annual gifts, which gave the frontier room to breathe, while the Song court in secret built forts in Hengshan and dug boundary ditches, chipping away at the depth of the Xia defence line step by step. Seen as a whole, the campaign of 982 destroyed neither Xia nor opened the road to the western regions; what it really did was push the Northern Song and Western Xia into a border war of attrition lasting more than three centuries, fought with forts, ditches, bows and crossbows and cavalry as its leading actors.
